name: CarouselBot
summary: AI tool that turns a topic or an article into LinkedIn and Instagram carousels, single social cards, branded long-form documents and batch content sets, in four aspect ratios with your own brand settings.
best_for: solo creators, consultants and small marketing teams who post LinkedIn and Instagram carousels every week and want to turn articles and ideas into branded slides without designing them by hand
skip_if: you want free-form layouts in a full design tool; you need scheduling and publishing in the same app, which the pricing page does not list; or you post a carousel only now and then and the watermark-free plans are more than you need
honest_knock: Free exports carry a watermark and the free card sets, batch and document are lifetime totals, not monthly. Creator allows only 3 batches a month. The refund window is 7 days, the cards do not name their currency, and Business is only a starting price.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-17 in a browser on carouselbot.app/pricing, Monthly and Annual views; the cards show a $ sign without naming the currency) Free is $0 forever: 3 carousels a month, plus 3 card sets, 1 batch collection and 1 document in total, up to 2,500 words per document, and PNG, JPG and PDF exports with a watermark. Creator is $10 a month, or $79 a year on annual billing (shown as $6.58 a month): unlimited carousels, 3 card sets, 3 batches and 10 documents a month, up to 5,000 words per document, no watermark. Pro is $30 a month, or $249 a year (shown as $20.75 a month): unlimited card sets, batches and documents, up to 10,000 words per document. The annual cards cross out $120 and $360, twelve monthly payments. Business is a starting price of $50 a month for agencies and teams, adding bulk creation from up to 50 URLs; its final price and billing are not stated. The FAQ offers a 7-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans, requested by email; after cancelling you keep access until the billing period ends, then drop to Free, and saved work stays in your library.

compare_with.name: Piktochart
compare_with.why: Piktochart is in our dossiers too: a template-based maker for infographics, reports and posters, with a free plan and Pro at $10 per member a month billed yearly when we read it on 19 September 2026. CarouselBot is narrower and more automatic: it generates the slides for social carousels and cards from your text, priced per account rather than per member.
